candidates.change_summary: Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to omit re-setting locked_ to false after function executes (leaves locked_ true), causing subsequent Put calls to revert and thus observable Put behavior differs.
In Put, set acc.unlockTime to _unlockTime unconditionally (remove the max with block.timestamp), allowing future behavior differences when _unlockTime is in the past.
Replace the external call to msg.sender with a transfer to change sending semantics and reentrancy behavior.
Change the conditional to require strictly greater than for balance check (acc.balance>_am) so some collects that previously succeeded now fail.
Remove resetting locked_ to false after function body to leave contract locked and change subsequent Collect behavior.
